title: DNP: Handle rollover by extending the sequence number
description:
Use unidirectional conversations for DNP 3.0 (ignoring the port but
using the DNP data link address) and store the last seen sequence
number, using it to extend the sequence number with cycle counting
similar to done for RTP.

This likely doesn't work if frames are out of order by more than
32 sequence numbers, but should handle most cases.

Fix #14437
